en: Entering the Poṣadha Hall, recite the verses:
"Our observance of the precepts is pure like the full moon; our body and speech are bright and stainless, free from defilement.
Being pure, harmonious, and without dispute, only then may we perform the Poṣadha together."
The water of eight virtues purifies all dust; Washing the palms removes defilement, and the mind is unstained.
Upholding the prohibitive precepts without transgression— May all sentient beings be thus.
The assembly of noble Arhats gathers; The multitude of ordinary beings is in harmony.
Bathed and purified with fragrant waters, they observe the *poṣadha* to deliver all sentient beings.
Sprinkled and washed with perfumed water, all defilements are cleansed away;

The Dharma-body is fully perfected, the five parts are complete, Prajñā shines forth perfectly, and liberation is fulfilled; All living beings assemble together, merging as one within the Dharma-realm.
The fragrance of precepts, the fragrance of meditative concentration, and the fragrance of liberation;
Cloud-palaces of radiant light pervade the worlds, making offerings to the infinite Buddhas of the ten directions. Seeing and hearing these, all are universally benefited as they realize nirvana;
This is the adamantine, unimpeded tally of liberation, the fruit of which is difficult to fathom.
I now joyfully receive this tally upon my head; may all sentient beings likewise fully possess this pure tally.
Having fully possessed this pure tally, they shall uphold the prohibitive precepts without deficiency or transgression; may all sentient beings likewise do so.
Pure as the full moon, pure in the bodily and verbal actions of the uposatha; only then is one equal to the uposatha.
The Buddhas appearing in the world is the foremost joy; hearing the Dharma and practicing it with devotion is the joy of delight.
The harmony of the great assembly is blissful; the liberation of sentient beings from suffering is blissful.
